bill.title: An Act prohibiting certain nondisclosure agreements between public agencies and data centers.

posted_text:
🏢 PA SB 1408 — Pennsylvania Limits What Public Agencies Can Hide About Data Centers

Pennsylvania is banning public agencies from signing agreements that restrict how they share information about data centers. This new law focuses on nondisclosure agreements between government bodies and data center owners or operators. If a public agency enters into such an agreement, preventing them from releasing details about the data center’s construction, operation, or location, the agreement becomes invalid. .. .... ..
